description: The file is a standalone PHP script designed for upgrading a SuiteCRM instance via command line, including functions for preparing the system, clearing caches, verifying arguments, managing upgrade progress, and executing the upgrade process.

classes.name: UpgradeHistory
classes.description: Represents a record of an upgrade process, storing details like filename, version, status, and description.

classes.name: SugarMerge
classes.description: Handles the merging of upgrade files using three-way merge operations during the upgrade process.

methods.name: prepSystemForUpgradeSilent
methods.description: Prepares system directories for upgrade, creating missing directories.

methods.name: clearCacheSU
methods.description: Recursively clears cache files with a specific extension within a directory.

methods.name: checkConfigForPermissions
methods.description: Checks and sets default permissions in config.php if missing.

methods.name: checkLoggerSettings
methods.description: Ensures logger configuration exists in config.php.

methods.name: checkLeadConversionSettings
methods.description: Ensures lead conversion activity options are set in config.php.

methods.name: checkResourceSettings
methods.description: Ensures resource management settings are defined in config.php.

methods.name: createMissingRels
methods.description: Creates missing relationship records in the database for core objects.

methods.name: merge_passwordsetting
methods.description: Merges default password settings into the configuration file.

methods.name: addDefaultModuleRoles
methods.description: Creates default module roles and associated ACL actions.

methods.name: verifyArguments
methods.description: Verifies and processes command line arguments for script execution.

methods.name: repairTableDictionaryExtFile
methods.description: Fixes extension table dictionary files by removing entries with non-existent files.
